title: Unit and composition laws for the explicit restricted transitions
statement: For any preordered I, diagram D : Iᵒᵖ → Over S, abelian etale coefficients F_i, transitions phi satisfying the heterogeneous identity and composition laws in lean.statement, and etale U over S, the explicit restricted complex transitions of [def-sbc-restricted-affine-single-maps] satisfy the canonical identity and composition equations, with transports along the map_id and map_comp equalities of the concrete restricted diagram [def-sbc-restricted-affine-coefficient-construction]. No cone, directedness, nonemptiness, or colimit is assumed.

source.place: Tag 09Z1 proof, restriction to an affine etale object; Tag 0EZM coefficient complexes; Tag 03CB canonical inverse-image composition comparisons

proof.text: Apply the identity component using hφid and the composition component using hφcomp, and pair the two proofs. Each component omits the other coefficient law, and neither alone gives the target conjunction.

lean.statement: theorem restrictedAffineSingleTransition_laws {S : Scheme.{v}} {I : Type v} [Preorder I] (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Over S) (F : ∀ i : I, Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).left.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}) (φ : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j), (((D.map f.op).left)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}]).obj (F i) ⟶ F j) (hφid : ∀ i : I, HEq (φ (𝟙 i)) ((upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (D.obj (op i)).left).hom.app (F i))) (hφcomp : ∀ {i j k : I} (f : i ⟶ j) (g : j ⟶ k), HEq (φ (f ≫ g)) ((upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (D.map g.op).left (D.map f.op).left).hom.app (F i) ≫ (((D.map g.op).left)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}]).map (φ f) ≫ φ g)) (U : S.Etale) : let D' := restrictedAffineDiagram D U let K := restrictedAffineK D F U let ψ := fun {i j : Iᵒᵖ} (f : j ⟶ i) ↦ restrictedAffineSingleTransition D F φ U f ( ∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, ψ (𝟙 i) = (NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex (eqToIso (congrArg (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}) (D'.map_id i))) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).hom.app (K i) ≫ (NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex (upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (D'.obj i)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).hom.app (K i)) ∧ ( ∀ (i j k : Iᵒᵖ) (f : j ⟶ i) (g : k ⟶ j), ψ (g ≫ f) = (NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (D'.map g) (D'.map f) (D'.map (g ≫ f)) (D'.map_comp g f)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).hom.app (K i) ≫ ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (D'.map g)).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map (ψ f) ≫ ψ g)
